claims.evidence: Witness report shows a black PlayStation-style console, but no readable brand/model text; PS4 Fat vs other models not confirmed.
Only one matching controller is shown in the witness photo report.
Witness report does not mention visible wear/scratches/cracks; condition details are not provided.
No internal/serial/inspection evidence is shown in the witness report.
No temperature/usage test or gameplay/boot evidence is shown.
No ports/cable connection test is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Only one controller is shown; receipt is not shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Exact console model may not be PS4 Fat (could be another PlayStation model or non-PS4 unit).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model text (rear/bottom sticker) and the controller model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/untested PlayStation-style console with controller.

risks.risk: Seller claims two controllers, but only one controller is shown; buyer may not receive the second pad.
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers together (front + back labels) and/or a video of both controllers pairing.

risks.risk: Power-on/functional status unknown (may not boot, read discs, or connect to HDMI/Wi‑Fi).
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on → home screen loads → controller works → game/disc test or at least HDMI output confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested (worst case) until a boot test is shown.

risks.risk: Controller health issues (stick drift, unresponsive buttons, weak battery) not visible in the single photo.
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller input test (on-screen stick movement) and button presses; also show charging/battery indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller with possible drift/unknown battery.

risks.risk: Storage and account readiness unknown (HDD size, wipe status, possible locked account).
risks.proof: Photo/video of system storage screen and a sign-out/wipe confirmation (or setup screen) after boot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown storage and not guaranteed wiped.

risks.risk: Physical damage not assessed (scratches/cracks, port damage) because the witness report doesn’t confirm condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of console corners, disc drive area, all ports, and controller seams/buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used with potential minor damage.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the console model/serial label (rear/bottom) and controller label.
Photo/video showing both controllers (if claiming double pad), including pairing to the console.
Video clip of the console powering on and reaching the home screen with the controller working.
Video clip showing HDMI output and either disc read test or game launch.
Photos/videos of all ports (USB/HDMI/Ethernet) with a cable connection test.
Photo/video of storage capacity screen and confirmation the system is wiped/ready for a new buyer account.
Close-up photos of console and controller for any cracks, bent ports, or damaged buttons/sticks.
response.reason: The witness confirms only a generic PlayStation-style console and one controller, with no readable model/condition/working tests. Without proof of exact PS4 Fat model, controller count, and functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
